description: Read one owned review with compact proposal rows, statuses and edit IDs. Each row has userEdited {value, note}; when the user changed your suggestion before approving it, suggestedAfter and suggestedReason hold what you suggested and after and reason hold what the user chose; revisions[] lists each change with who made it, before and after, and restored_to_agent when your original was put back. Duplications include copies[].status (pending, approved, made, partial, failed, rejected), group for split post requests, and review-wide summary.copies totals including partial. A partial copy already exists: report its id, currentName, failedStep, plain error and retry hint; retry only that step from your Agent Inbox, never run the copy again. Returns 50 proposals by default; use paging.after for more or detail: full for full proposal data. Both preview detail levels report settings.launch (allowed, approval or off) separately from the edit mode; settings.approvalRuleAppliesTo is edits. Edit approval does not gate new-ad launches. Review mode returns reviewUrl and no executable plan. Share reviewUrl with the user, do not apply, and reuse reviewId on later previews in the same conversation. EDITS_REVIEW_REQUIRED means approval must happen in your Agent Inbox. Always preview and show the user the changes. Set a confirm flag only after the user explicitly approves that change. Never retry a partial apply blindly. Archive and delete cannot be undone. Preview requests accept optional reason and runTitle. A per-operation reason overrides the top-level reason for that operation. Use one short evidence-based note for the Agent Inbox and reuse runTitle with the same reviewId.

detail.description: Compact rows by default. Full includes operations, changes and editable fields.
